description: This file contains unit tests for the MotionHandler class in an Android application. It verifies the behavior of motion activity handling and pedometer functionality, using mock data sources and JUnit assertions.

classes.name: MotionHandlerTest
classes.description: A test class for MotionHandler, containing various test cases verifying permission handling, JSON validation, and payload content.

methods.name: handleMotionActivity_requiresPermission
methods.description: Tests that motion activity handling requires permission and returns the appropriate error when permission is missing.

methods.name: handleMotionActivity_rejectsInvalidJson
methods.description: Tests the handler's response to invalid JSON input.

methods.name: handleMotionActivity_returnsActivityPayload
methods.description: Verifies that valid motion activity data returns a successful response with correct payload content.

methods.name: handleMotionPedometer_mapsRangeUnsupportedError
methods.description: Checks that an unsupported pedometer error maps to the correct error code and message.
